1813. Access Control Analyzer using Public and Private

Medium

Access Control Analyzer using Public and Private

Problem Statement:
Design a system to analyze member accessibility under different inheritance modes.

Description:
Base Class: Account
Members:
1. public: accountNumber
2. protected: balance
3. private: pin

Derived Class 1: SavingsAccount (public inheritance)
Derived Class 2: SecureAccount (private inheritance)

Requirements:
1. Attempt accessing all base members inside derived classes.
2. Attempt accessing base members from main().
3. Demonstrate how access levels change in private inheritance.
4. Show compilation-safe implementation.
5. Print accessible member details.

Input Format:
Account Number
Balance
PIN

Output Format:
Accessible members printed.
